RESEARCH SUPPORT

Funding

Our integrated research is supported through a combination of federal competitive funding and commodity-group competitive funding. The Solanki Lab is currently supported through programs from the National Science Foundation (NSF), U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA), and commodity groups supporting corn, soybean, and wheat research. This support enables our research while providing opportunities for graduate and undergraduate students to participate in discovery and training. We gratefully acknowledge all organizations and stakeholders who support our work.
